what: PIPELINE, a browser arcade skateboard game set on a fictional Greek Row. It runs on Vite, plain ESM and Canvas 2D, with a Cloudflare Worker for a live player queue.
audience: Players of a free single-player browser game. The game is satire, and it names real campuses as settings only.
landing_job: The title screen starts a run. It shows the PIPELINE wordmark, a starting-look picker, campus and route choices, a skip-training toggle and the live player count.

palette.role: Accent: eyebrow, logo drop shadow, brand bar shadow
Sky: page gradient top and theme colour
Sun: highlight and logo gradient end

type.role: Display: eyebrow, logo, tagline, brand (italic 800 to 900)
type.family: 'Avenir Next Condensed', 'Futura', 'Bahnschrift', 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif (system stack, no font file)
'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif (system stack)

identity.look: A bright daylight pop palette: a sky-blue page gradient, a white card, condensed italic display type and a pink offset shadow on the rotated PIPELINE wordmark.

notes: No design-system folder, tokens or brand book exist. The live identity (PIPELINE, styles.css) differs from the older handoff (FRATTY PIPELINE, black and paper, Archivo Black and VT323 at design_handoff_fratty_pipeline/design/styles.css:2,5-15; design/index.html:6). A system must pick one. The only logo file is an app icon. The wordmark is plain type (styles.css:170-186). public/audio/fratty-pipeline.mp3 is a private, unpublished recording and was not read.
